author: Bruno Mulé
title: Brandon Nimmo goes deep in loss to Marlins
desc: Brandon Nimmo went 2-for-5 with a home run, a triple, and two RBI in Tuesday's 6-4 loss to the Marlins. He homered in the eighth inning for his first long ball of the month before adding an RBI triple in the ninth.
impact: Nimmo is hitting .312 in June and has a seven-game hitting streak with five multi-hit games during that stretch. He is slashing .271/.337/.435 with eight home runs, 28 RBI, 32 runs, and three steals across 332 plate appearances.

author: Bruno Mulé
title: Jose Corniell takes loss in season debut
desc: Jose Corniell (0-1) took the loss Tuesday against the Marlins after allowing five runs on seven hits and two walks over 3.1 innings. He struck out three. Corniell entered in relief of Cal Quantrill in the third inning, allowed one run in the fourth, and then gave up four more in the fifth.
impact: Corniell has allowed eight earned runs over five innings across two major-league appearances between 2025 and 2026. His role remains unclear, but he could pitch again this weekend against the Blue Jays if he remains part of the group replacing Jack Leiter.

author: Bruno Mulé
title: Nate Eaton sets tone atop lineup
desc: Nate Eaton went 3-for-4 with two doubles, two runs, two RBI, a walk, and a stolen base in Tuesday's 5-2 win over Colorado. He started in left field with Jarren Duran at designated hitter and batted leadoff for the first time.
impact: Eaton reached base four times after entering Tuesday with three times on base over 10 plate appearances. He has started three of Boston's last four games, and Tuesday's performance could lead to more lineup opportunities.

author: Bruno Mulé
title: Ceddanne Rafaela records RBI, steal in win
desc: Ceddanne Rafaela went 1-for-5 with an RBI and a stolen base in Tuesday's 5-2 win over the Rockies. He drove in Boston's final run with an RBI single in the sixth inning.
impact: Rafaela is slashing .280/.330/.437 with seven home runs, 33 RBI, nine steals, and 31 runs over 73 games. He has been batting second for the last 24 games after earning a promotion in the order.

author: Bruno Mulé
title: Francisco Alvarez launches sixth homer
desc: Francisco Alvarez went 2-for-4 with a home run and three RBI in Tuesday's 9-6 loss to the Cubs. He drove in the Mets' first two runs with a two-run single in his first plate appearance before adding a 403-foot solo homer off Phil Maton in the seventh inning.
impact: Alvarez has hit safely in nine of 11 games since returning from the injured list on June 9, batting .300 over that span.

author: Bruno Mulé
title: Bo Bichette blasts late homer in loss to Cubs
desc: Bo Bichette went 2-for-4 with a two-run home run and a walk in Tuesday's 9-6 loss to the Cubs. He hit a two-run shot off Jayden Murray in the ninth inning for his ninth homer of the season.
impact: Bichette is batting .405 with 10 RBI over his last 10 games and has raised his average from .213 on June 2 to .251 entering Wednesday. He owns a .674 OPS with 11 doubles, one triple, nine home runs, 44 RBI, 40 runs, and one stolen base through 341 plate appearances.

author: Bruno Mulé
title: Kodai Senga struggles again in loss to Cubs
desc: Kodai Senga (0-6) took the loss Tuesday against the Cubs, allowing seven runs on three hits and five walks while striking out six over 3.2 innings. He opened with two strikeouts in the first inning, but the second unraveled after two walks, a hit batter, and a three-run homer by Pete Crow-Armstrong. Senga later allowed a two-run homer to Dansby Swanson in the fourth.
impact: Senga has allowed 27 earned runs over his last five starts while failing to complete more than four innings in any of them. He owns a 10.08 ERA, 1.92 WHIP, and 34:22 K:BB through 27.2 innings, and manager Carlos Mendoza suggested he could be removed from the rotation in the near future.

author: Bruno Mulé
title: Wilyer Abreu powers Red Sox past Rockies
desc: Wilyer Abreu went 2-for-4 with a home run, two RBI, and a stolen base in Tuesday's 5-2 win over the Rockies. He drove in Boston's first run with a triple in the opening inning, then walked and stole second in the third before adding a solo homer off Sean Sullivan in the fifth.
impact: Abreu is slashing .279/.344/.452 with 10 home runs, 35 runs scored, 38 RBI, and six steals across 324 plate appearances.

author: Bruno Mulé
title: Sonny Gray strikes out 11 in win over Rockies
desc: Sonny Gray earned the win Tuesday against the Rockies after allowing one run over seven innings at Coors Field. He struck out 11 while allowing six hits and three walks. The only run came on a solo homer by Willi Castro in the second inning.
impact: Gray will carry a 2.95 ERA, 1.19 WHIP, and 66:20 K:BB across 76.1 innings into a home start against the Yankees on Sunday.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Victor Caratini provides pop in lopsided loss
desc: Victor Caratini went 1-for-4 in Tuesday's 12-3 loss to the Dodgers with a solo home run, one run scored, and one RBI.
impact: Caratini continued his recent hot hitting as he is batting .391 with three homers and seven RBI over his past seven contests. Through 58 games, he's batting .236 with six homers, 30 RBI, 18 runs scored, a .309 wOBA, and a .261 BABIP.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Brooks Lee hits a solo shot in lopsided loss
desc: Brooks Lee went 1-for-4 in a 12-3 loss to the Dodgers on Tuesday with a home run, a run scored, and one RBI.
impact: Lee supplied a rare bright spot for Minnesota as the offense got flattened. After Tuesday's loss, Lee is batting .238 with 13 home runs, 45 RBI, 37 runs scored, and three stolen bases across 77 games. He's hitting .258 with two homers and six RBI over his past seven contests.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Kendry Rojas fights command in short outing vs. Dodgers
desc: Kendry Rojas wasn't exactly painting corners, but he at least missed enough bats to avoid a full-blown mess.
impact: Kendry Rojas allowed one earned run on one hit and three walks while striking out four over two innings in Tuesday's 12-3 loss to the Dodgers. After Tuesday's outing, Rojas now has a 1-0 record to go with a 1.65 ERA and 1.53 WHIP across six appearances.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Kahlil Watson's solo shot isn't enough in 2-1 loss
desc: Kahlil Watson went 2-for-4 in Tuesday's loss to the White Sox with a home run, one run scored, and one RBI.
impact: Watson kept things from getting completely dull, but Cleveland still found a way to waste it. The homer was Watson's first of his career, a 373-foot blast with an exit velocity of 104.7 MPH. Through six games this season, he's hitting .177 with one homer, three RBI, and one stolen base.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Parker Messick fans 10 but takes tough-luck loss
desc: Parker Messick allowed two earned runs on three hits and one walk while striking out 10 over 7.2 innings in Tuesday's 2-1 loss to the White Sox.
impact: Messick was sharp but got little support in a low-scoring defeat. After Tuesday's outing, Messick now has a 2.67 ERA and 1.05 WHIP with a 7-4 record and 101 strikeouts across 16 starts. His next start will be Monday against the Rangers.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Sean Sullivan battles control issues in loss to Red Sox
desc: Sean Sullivan allowed three earned runs on five hits and five walks while striking out three over five innings in Tuesday's loss to the Red Sox.
impact: After the defeat, Sullivan now has an 8.25 ERA and 1.92 WHIP with a 0-2 record through three starts. His five walks are concerning, as the young starter as seven walks over his last nine innings. He is currently slated to take on Miami in his next start.
